ref.locator: vlaanderen.be 'Hoeveel verdien je in het onderwijs?', section 'Voorbeeld van een salaris als leraar secundair onderwijs', row 'Master + bewijs van pedagogische bekwaamheid (bpb)', salarisschaal 501, Tijdelijk, 0 jaar, column Bruto (euro); coefficient from 'Indexering salaris onderwijspersoneel', row 01.09.2026 x 2,2080
ref.quote: Geïndexeerd bruto maandsalaris voor een ongehuwde leerkracht zonder personen ten laste (indexcoëfficient 2,2080 - september 2026). … Master + bewijs van pedagogische bekwaamheid (bpb) | 501 | Tijdelijk | 0 jaar | 4.041,66 | 2.669,28
ref.note: Checked by a second agent: Re-downloaded: 4.041,66 gross/month for scale 501, 0 years, confirmed; 4,041.66 x 12 = 48,499.92 confirmed; indexation page confirms 'Jaarsalaris aan 100% x 1/12 x coëfficiënt = brutomaandsalaris' and 2,2080 from 01.09.2026 (2,1647 from 01.03.2026, 2,1223 before that, so the 2026 calendar-year amount is lower). Value is right; labels corrected because 'jaarlonen / salaires annuels / yearly salaries' would read as the teacher's full yearly pay, while the amount is 12 gross monthly salaries only (no holiday pay, year-end bonus or employer contributions). Neutral; three languages now say the same thing. Year 2026 (rate since 1 Sept 2026). Researcher's working: 4,041.66 €/month gross × 12 = 48,499.92 €/year. Cross-check: the indexation page (source vl-onderwijs-indexering-salaris) gives 'Jaarsalaris aan 100% x 1/12 x coëfficiënt = brutomaandsalaris' with coefficient 'x 2,2080' from '01.09.2026'. Gross salary at the rate in force since 1 September 2026 (from 1 March to 31 August 2026 the coefficient was 2.1647, so the 2026 calendar-year average is slightly lower). Not included: holiday pay (vakantiegeld), year-end bonus (eindejaarstoelage), employer social contributions, and pensions of appointed teachers (paid by the federal government, not by Flanders). Scale 501 applies to master's holders with a teaching qualification in secondary education; many teachers are on other scales (e.g. 301 for bachelor's holders: 3,260.16 €/month gross at 0 years on the same page). It is a starting salary, below the average teacher salary. The official scale page data-onderwijs.vlaanderen.be (barema 501) was unreachable from here (TLS connection dropped), so the monthly figure on the ministry's own example page was used.

ref.locator: Statistiek Vlaanderen 'Onderwijsbegroting' (published 12 February 2026), section 'Meer budget per leerling in gewoon secundair dan per leerling in gewoon basisonderwijs', first paragraph
ref.quote: Per leerling in het gewoon basisonderwijs werd in 2025 gemiddeld 7.600 euro uitgegeven, per leerling in het gewoon secundair onderwijs 11.800 euro.
ref.note: 2025 figure (published February 2026); no 2026 figure yet. It is a rounded average from the Flemish administrative education budget divided by pupil numbers (source: Statistisch Jaarboek van het Vlaams onderwijs), so it covers salaries and operating grants; it is not the operating grant (werkingsmiddelen) alone. Special-needs secondary education costs much more (nearly 26,800 euro per pupil on the same page).

IV, 4.4 'Onderwijs en Vorming': p. 58 (loonkredieten onderwijspersoneel: lonen basis- en secundair onderwijs), p. 60 (werkingskredieten per onderwijsniveau; studiefinanciering hoger onderwijs, FD0-1FGE2HA-WT), p. 61 (basisfinanciering universiteiten en hogescholen, FD0-1FEE2EA-IS). Same articles in vp-19-2025-2026-nr10-bijlagen-1 pp. 47-48, 55 (LONEN BASISONDERWIJS, LONEN SECUNDAIR ONDERWIJS, WERKING GEWOON BASISONDERWIJS, HOGER ONDERWIJS – BASISFINANCIERING, STUDIEFINANCIERING)
ref.quote: Binnen het beleidsdomein Onderwijs en Vorming vormen de loonkredieten van het onderwijspersoneel de voornaamste uitgavenpost.
ref.note: Teacher pay follows statutory pay scales and staffing is allocated by decree-based rules (omkadering); a cut or increase in practice means changing those rules. 'Studietoelagen' = studiefinanciering hoger onderwijs (the secondary-school allowance is paid via the Groeipakket, in the welfare line). Universities and university colleges get a block grant (basisfinanciering) and decide themselves how to spend it. corrected: source re-downloaded, quote verbatim at p. 58 and other locators confirmed (pp. 60-61; printed = PDF page). Study-grant phrase now says 'in higher education' (the budget item is studiefinanciering hoger onderwijs, FD0-1FGE2HA-WT). French shortened. Flag 3 (teacher staffing by decree): kept 'fewer/more teachers' because the money pays teacher salaries and the staffing rules are the official lever; caveat already says a change means changing those rules; no phrase claims an automatic effect.
